rationale: The offering is described as training content packs containing demonstrations, simulations, job aids and assessments, plus a kit to customize or create content. These are conventional instructional-content functions; no AI operation is described.
evidence_spans: Our ART Content Packs contain Show-Me demonstrations, Hands-On Try-Me simulations, step-by-step job aids and assessments.
Use the ART Developer Kit to customize the Content Pack or create your own content for your Learning Management System (LMS) and Webserver.
conflict_response: The description explicitly frames the offering as content packs and content customization, with examples of the material supplied. It does not establish how the simulations run or that the developer kit is included, and I do not infer either point; the stated instructional-content function is nevertheless meaningful conventional functionality.
